comparison.objective: Extract exactly one chip from a packet and place it on a plate while leaving the others inside.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective grasping in clutter and disturbance-limited extraction from a container.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one chip clears and rests on the plate; two remain contained; packet stays upright and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Both penalize unintended object loss, but chip selection from an open container does not test flush support mating, parallel-axis maintenance, or constrained bearing-block sliding.
